Logging in to DelftBlue

DelftBlue is TU Delft’s high-performance computing system. You connect to it remotely from your computer.

Learning objectives

By the end of this module, you will be able to:

  • Connect to DelftBlue using a terminal or SSH client
  • Recognize a successful login
  • Verify your username and current computer
  • Log out safely

Before you begin

You need:

  • An active TU Delft NetID
  • An internet connection
  • Permission to access DelftBlue
Quick check

I already have DelftBlue access, or I have requested it.

  • Access to the TU Delft network or eduVPN
Quick check

I am on the TU Delft network, or I have connected to eduVPN.

  • An SSH client

Check your network connection

When you are on campus, connect through the TU Delft network.

When you are off campus, connect to the TU Delft network using eduVPN through Institute Access.
